prompt_passes.goal: Deepen9 existing household categories into useful standalone buying decisions; preserve100 real models and USD100 total-site monthly goal

prompt_passes.constraints: Original source-based editorial reasoning, translated EN/DE/ZH, no tests/stock/prices/search volumes/competitor performance invented; preserve actual dates and marketplace disclosure

prompt_passes.acceptance: 27 crawlable static pages, source links/useful comparisons, canonical/hreflang/schema/text parity, sitemap/IndexNow, privacy-safe pageview and affiliate tracking, independent review and live verification

self_challenges.challenge: Would this merely multiply thin category templates or copy manufacturer prose?
self_challenges.response: Nine distinct task-focused guides, actual compare/skip criteria and checklists; no100 per-product pages or new country variants. Human-independent content review before release.

self_challenges.challenge: Could SEO/GEO artefacts or a notification be misreported as indexed content, new traffic or revenue?
self_challenges.response: Official Google guidance rejects special GEO markup requirements; distinguish release, accepted notification, crawl/index/search impressions, AI citation and mature merchant revenue. Keep reporting unknown without authentic read evidence.

competitors.name: Good Housekeeping
competitors.observable: Household directory links to distinct room/task/product guides and states its testing methods.
competitors.tds_gap: Existing nine groups were only inventory sections on one catalog; no standalone buying explanation.
competitors.action: One original guide per existing category, task criteria, related guides and source trail.
competitors.limits: Publisher testing claims are its own; TDS has no lab or independent hands-on test. No verified competitor traffic, CTR or sales-conversion data.

competitors.name: Wirecutter
competitors.observable: Its official help center describes editorial/product-testing standards and feature-comparison tables.
competitors.tds_gap: Short use/check cards alone did not explain competing approaches or prerequisites.
competitors.action: Explain need/consider/trade-off, link comparison examples to visible named models, disclose published-source methodology.
competitors.limits: TDS adopts transparent reasoning, not a tested-best claim or Wirecutter scale. No measured TDS conversion lift.

additional_reference_limit: ThisIsWhyImBroke homebodies URL returned a JavaScript/404 template in the current text fetch. Do not treat internal template zero metrics as real CTR or conversion evidence; retained previous catalog research is historical.

official_guidance.decision: Foundational SEO, indexable eligible pages and useful visible content also apply to Google AI features.
No special AI file/schema requirement; Google says llms.txt does not affect its visibility. Existing mirrors are optional convenience, not an indexing tactic.
Notify actual added/changed/deleted URLs after public deployment and key proof. Acceptance does not guarantee indexing.
